title: Peer/receipt: no e2e test for wrong-caller forgery
description: ReceiptHandler validates that the caller's WhoIs identity is the contact_id for the chat, but no e2e test exercises the rejection path. Scenarios missing: (1) Peer A sends receipt for message in Peer B's chat, (2) receipt for nonexistent message, (3) receipt that references a chat the caller isn't part of. The fix for Peer/receipt auth bypass (KITH-orvy.2) is correct but unverified at the HTTP level. — Add e2e tests using state-counter-as-oracle pattern (existing e2e.rs shows how): send receipt as wrong peer, assert 4xx + no state change.
